title: OpenID Connect: Orchard Core as an Identity Provider | Orchard Core
description:
When several applications each keep their own accounts and passwords, people sign in again and again, and access has to be managed in every one of them.

The OpenID Connect module turns Orchard Core into an identity provider. People sign in with their Orchard Core user accounts, and applications receive tokens that say who they are and what they may do. The module can also check tokens for the API of your site, and let people sign in to your site through another identity provider.
